During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] used the handle '''wampa1''' as his user ID while posting on [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] message threads. The user, whose posted comments did not relate to the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in any way, was a poor speller with a particularly confrontational attitude.
